data.name: Decay Breath VR
data.detailed_description:
Decay Breath VR is an immersive VR survival shooter that takes you into a post-apocalyptic world filled with zombie figures. Three years after the outbreak of the disaster, you will wake up from the incubator and face a ruined world. As a survivor, you must rely on your wits to survive in this dangerous world and uncover the truth about the world's past.

Game Characteristics ：

Hard gun assembly and shooting

Realistic gun assembly system, players can disassemble and assemble magazines, magnifiers, sights and manually stuff bullets. Personally adjust weapon parts and assemble your firearms, enjoy every moment of pleasure from precision shooting. Use customized weapons to accurately shoot heads or sever limbs to repel the surging zombie army.

Rich Melee System

The game offers a variety of melee weapons, such as knives, swords, hammers, axes, etc. You can use these weapons to dismember the zombies and experience the real battle feeling. In addition, you can also use temporary items in the environment to attack, such as stones, bricks, glass bottles, trash can lids and so on. Every prop and weapon can be a sharp weapon for you to fight with the zombies, allowing you to experience a creative combat and survival feeling like never before.

Highly Interactive Physics Engine

The immersive physics interaction system allows you to freely open doors, grab props, climb obstacles, zipline across and more. You can also use a hanging ring to cross a bridge or directly  hit  a zombie with your fists. Each action will directly affect your survival and combat strategy.

Gameplay：

Group Episode Mode.

Team up with a friend and explore the post-apocalyptic world cooperatively in a heart-wrenching storyline adventure! You will face unknown challenges, unlock hidden secrets, live and die together, and experience the true feeling of apocalyptic survival.

Endless Corpse Mode

Challenge the endless tide of zombies with your teammates. Each challenge is tougher than the last, who can last until the end in this life and death test？

  • In Breath of Decay you will experience:

  • Fine gun assembly and operation

  • The feeling of dismembering zombies with melee weapons such as knives, hammers, axes, etc.

  • Creative ways to fight with zombies using props around you

  • Immersive physical and environmental interactions

  • Fight alongside your friends against the endless tide of zombies.

Ready for the challenge? The fate of the post-apocalyptic world is in your hands.

data.short_description: In Decay Breath VR you'll experience detailed gun assembly and operation, the exhilaration of using weapons to dismember zombies, and creative combat styles that utilize props to fight zombies. Immersive physical and environmental interactions as well as the ability to team up and play online.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Thai, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: i7-9700K or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 - or equivalent with at least 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR. Quest; Rift, Rift S; Valve Index; WMR HP Reverb G2; HTC Vive and Vive Pro Supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required, VR Headset required. The native resolution and refresh rate of your VR headset will affect your performance.

content_descriptors.notes: In the game, there is violent dismemberment of zombies, bloodshed, as well as choking and smoking.
